content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The licence analogue here is the Terminal Station Right of Use (Subparagraph 11.1), granted to the Parties for the duration of the Agreement and extended only to IRU purchasers (11.5). It is not revocable at the grantor's discretion, so no walk-away issue.

- **Fallback element 2 (successor transfer) — already met:** Subparagraph 22.3(a) permits assignment of the whole of a Party's rights and obligations to a successor at any time without Management Committee consent, reinforced by Paragraph 30 (Successors Bound).
- **Fallback element 1 (affiliates on written notice) — failed:** No clause extends the right of use to affiliates. The Affiliate references in 12.8/12.14 govern capacity use and transfer and are conditioned on Carrier status plus a cash contribution; 22.3(c) is an outright transfer of the whole interest, not affiliate coverage.

Cure: one inserted subparagraph 11.5A extending the Terminal Station Right of Use to a Party's Affiliates, Subsidiaries and Parent Company on written notice (the defined "Affiliate" reaches only 10–50% holdings, hence naming subsidiaries and parent). No preferred-level perpetuity/irrevocability language was volunteered, and unrelated text is untouched.
